question: On 13 July 2021, the *Badminton World* Federation (BWF) officially allocated which country to host the BWF World Championships for 2026?
solution:
The correct answer is __**India.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• It is also known as **IBF World Championships**.
 
• The tournament is among the most prestigious in badminton, offering the most ranking points, together with the **Summer Pumpics Badminton Tournaments**.
 
• It was introduced in **1992.**
 
• The winner of these tournaments are also crowned as **"World Champions" **of the sport and are awarded a **gold medal**.
 
• It is held once every **three years**.
 
• In the starting it was hosted by **IBF(International Badminton Federation).** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
